visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with short hair and a bright smile, wearing a purple fuzzy cardigan, holds a traditional gold alarm clock in her right hand and a modern smartphone in her left. She stands in a room with a white pegboard wall decorated with a small cactus and wooden shelves. (2) The camera cuts to a tight close-up of a smartphone screen showing a long, vertical list of set alarms ranging from 6:35 AM to late morning. Fingers scroll rapidly through dozens of individual alarm entries. (3) The scene shifts to an office environment where a different woman in a white puffer jacket is shown from the torso up, displaying her phone's alarm list to the camera. (4) Multiple cuts follow as the interviewer moves through an office, showing various colleagues at their desks; some wear hats or glasses, and they all interact by holding up their phones to reveal their alarm settings. The background is a typical busy office with monitors, cubicles, and merchandise. (5) A man with a navy blue cap and glasses sits in an ergonomic office chair, gesturing towards his phone while talking. (6) Another man with black-rimmed glasses and a khaki vest is shown in a medium shot, looking at his phone and laughing. (7) The final phase shows the first woman and another colleague laughing together in the office setting, with a cluttered desk of snacks and toys visible in the background.
